messages:
Sam: Quick question — I started on Sep 20 and HR told me PTO accrues monthly. Do I get the full month for Sept or is it prorated? Also, I have unpaid parental leave in Nov — do sick days keep accruing while I'm on that leave?
Ava: Welcome Sam! We prorate the first partial month. Example: if monthly accrual = 8 hrs and you worked 11/30 days, you get 8 * 11/30 ≈ 2.93 hrs for Sept.
Ava: For unpaid LOAs (parental leave without pay) standard policy is that PTO and sick accruals pause during the unpaid period. Benefits continuation is a separate election.
Sam: Got it — thanks. Curious follow-up: we have a contractor converting to 0.8 FTE — does their accrual follow the same proration?
Diego: Yes, accruals are pro-rated by FTE. So contractor on 0.8 FTE with a monthly accrual of 8 hrs for FT would get 8 * 0.8 = 6.4 hrs/month (then prorate partial months).
Priya: If you want the exact math I can run it. Also note we allow limited exceptions: managers can request a manual carryover override for people on extended LOA, but it needs People Ops signoff before payroll close.
Ava: Quick formula we usually share in messages: 
```
prorated_accrual = base_monthly_accrual * FTE_fraction * (days_worked_in_month / days_in_month)
```
Ava: Example for Sam: base 8 * 1.0 * (11/30) = 2.93 hrs. For contractor 8 * 0.8 * (15/31) = 3.87 hrs.
Sam: Perfect — thanks. One more: is there any flexibility on the carryover cap if someone can't use PTO because of an extended launch blackout?
Priya: Carryover cap for FT is 80 hrs by default. Exceptions are granted case-by-case; for launch-related blackout we typically require manager justification + People Ops approval and we document it in the HR ticket.
hr-bot: FYI: PTO carryover exception requests must be submitted by payroll cutoff to be applied to the same calendar year. Deadline: this Friday at 5pm PT.
Ava: If you need me to file an override for someone on your team, drop the manager justification here or DM and we'll initiate the override before cutoff.
Sam: I'm going to ask my manager to write the justification today. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup: 
Priya: I'll follow up with payroll once you share the justification.
Sam: Shared — received confirmation from Priya via DM. Appreciate the quick responses.
